svg.text: Reported capabilities of CT interpretation and evidence-review systems
Sources reviewed 2026-11-27. Statuses follow the definitions in docs/RELATED_WORK.md; details and locations in docs/related_work/source_matrix.md.
Complete system, CT and other 3D, ICML 2026
Standalone model, chest and abdominal CT, ...
Implemented: in our code and run records (not a validation). Documented: the source shows it. Partial: only the named part is shown. Not reported: not described in the examined sources.
Not reported does not mean absent. More features do not mean better or clinically superior.
